ValidationRule.description: 3 sales process fields need to be entered when closing and opportunity =AGP
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"),
OR( ISBLANK ( CurrentState__c ), ISBLANK (Future_State__c), ISBLANK ( Gap__c ) ), OR( RecordType.Name = "Accelerated-AGP") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete "Current State", "Future State", and "Gap" fields when the stage is Closed Won
